jobs.title: Highways Development Management Engineer
jobs.description:
Vacancies

Highways Development Management Engineer

About The Role

At West Northamptonshire Council, we’re looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Highways Development Management Engineer to join our Highways and Transport Service. You’ll be at the heart of shaping how new developments across the area impact our transport network, ensuring they deliver safe, high-quality and sustainable solutions.

In this role, you will assess the transport and highways impacts of planning applications, provide clear and practical technical advice, and negotiate with developers to secure the right improvements. You’ll play a key part in managing and coordinating developer contributions, including Section 106 and Section 278 agreements, and oversee the design and delivery of highways works funded by developers to ensure they meet the highest standards.

You’ll also work closely with colleagues, elected members, stakeholders and local communities to help create accessible, efficient and sustainable transport networks that support growth and improve quality of life across West Northamptonshire.

What will you be doing?

You will be based in the Highways Development Team and work closely with colleagues across the wider transport service. Your role will focus on assessing the transport and highways impacts of new developments and ensuring that appropriate and sustainable infrastructure is delivered as part of the planning process.

Day to day, you will provide technical highways and transport advice on planning applications, negotiate with developers to secure necessary improvements, and oversee the design and delivery of works funded through Section 106 and Section 278 agreements. You will be responsible for coordinating developer contributions, ensuring they are effectively managed and aligned with local transport priorities.

Collaboration will be at the heart of your work, as you will engage regularly with planning, regeneration, and transport colleagues, as well as developers, contractors, and local stakeholders. You will also take ownership of budget management, risk monitoring, and progress reporting to ensure that all highways and transport improvements are delivered to a high standard.

An important part of your role will be helping to embed improved processes for managing developer funding, working with planning colleagues to make sure contributions are secured, allocated, and delivered efficiently.

About You

You should have a solid understanding of highways engineering principles and the development management process, together with knowledge of planning legislation, transport policy, and sustainability issues relevant to local government. Strong interpersonal and communication skills are essential, as you will be working closely with colleagues, developers, planners, and other stakeholders to secure and deliver high-quality transport solutions.

You will be confident in reviewing technical drawings and transport assessments, able to provide clear advice and recommendations, and skilled at negotiating outcomes that balance growth with sustainable transport objectives. The ability to work independently, use your initiative, and manage competing priorities under pressure is vital.

Ideally, you will hold a degree in a relevant discipline such as civil engineering, highways, or transport planning, and have experience of preparing and presenting technical reports. Project management training and experience in handling Section 106 and Section 278 agreements would be an advantage, alongside a motivation to further develop your expertise in highways development management.

Our benefits

You can also see our full list of employee benefits on our careers site here: Why you should work for us | West Northamptonshire Council.

About Us

At West Northants Council, it’s about our people. People who thrive with ambition, bubble with new ideas, demand better ways of working, caring about every detail, and who never shy away from a challenge. Our culture is a gateway for new experiences. A place to forge new opportunities. To empower you in your career and unite you with like-minded people.

Our vision is ‘to make West Northants a great place to live, work, visit and thrive’. We truly stand by this and work hard every day to make this a reality. Our corporate values, THRIVE, stand for: Trust, High Performance, Respect, Innovate and Empower, they underpin everything we do and how we deliver services.

We are committed to ensuring diversity, equality, equity, and inclusion is woven into the fabric of WNC and everything we do, to enable all colleagues to develop and maximize their full potential.  We are a disability confident employer, a member of the Armed Forces Covenant, and a Care Leaver Covenant partner

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d) - dein Quereinstieg aus Optik, Hörakustik oder Autohandel
jobs.description:
Über die Rolle

Du kennst dich aus im Optiker-, Hörakustik- oder Autohaus-Alltag
– mit Kund:innen, Beratung und dem täglichen Spagat zwischen Filiale und Zentrale? Genau dieses Wissen suchen wir. Bei hellomateo betreuen wir hunderte Kund:innen aus genau diesen Branchen, und wir wissen: Niemand versteht ihre Herausforderungen besser als jemand, der selbst mittendrin gearbeitet hat.
Steig bei uns als Customer Success Manager:in ein und bring dein Branchenwissen in ein wachsendes Software-Startup ein. 💚

Über uns
🐨

Wir bei hellomateo machen den Mittelstand wettbewerbsfähig, indem wir seine Kundenbeziehung durch ein persönliches Kommunikationserlebnis stärken. Über 2.000 Unternehmen
wie Rock am Ring, Grohe, Vero Moda, R+V und die Sparkasse setzen bereits auf hellomateo. In den letzten zwei Jahren sind wir um das 4-Fache gewachsen
– und das ist erst der Anfang. 🚀

Aufgaben
In diesen Bereichen machst du den Unterschied:

💻 Onboarding & Betreuung
: Du führst neue Kund:innen aus Optik, Hörakustik und Autohandel eigenständig durch das Onboarding und begleitest sie danach dauerhaft.

📚 Beratung auf Augenhöhe
: Weil du die Branche kennst, verstehst du sofort, wo bei deinen Kund:innen der Schuh drückt – und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen die passende Lösung.

🗣️ Kundenbeziehung ausbauen
: Du baust vertrauensvolle, langfristige Beziehungen zu deinen Kund:innen auf und sorgst dafür, dass sie hellomateo optimal nutzen.

🔎 Erfolg messen & steigern
: Du analysierst Nutzungsdaten deiner Kund:innen, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und sprichst Upsell-Chancen aktiv an.

🤝 Feedback zurückspielen
: Du bist die Stimme deiner Branche im Unternehmen und bringst Kund:innen-Feedback direkt ins Produkt- und Sales-Team ein.

🚀 Schnittstelle sein
: Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Support und Produkt zusammen und trägst aktiv dazu bei, wie wir Kund:innen aus deiner Branche in Zukunft noch besser betreuen.

Qualifikation
Das Wichtigste für diese Rolle ist deine Freude am Umgang mit Menschen – ob im direkten Kontakt mit Kund:innen oder im engen Austausch mit dem Team.

Das bringst du idealerweise mit:

Du hast bereits im Optiker-, Hörakustik- oder Autohandel-Umfeld gearbeitet
– z.B. in Beratung, Verkauf, Filialleitung oder vergleichbarer Kundenbetreuung. Software- oder SaaS-Erfahrung brauchst du dafür nicht.

Du kommunizierst klar und freundlich - auf Deutsch (C2)
und auf Englisch (B2).Du hast Lust, dein Branchenwissen in eine neue berufliche Richtung im Tech-Umfeld einzubringen.

Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich
, auch wenn mehrere Kund:innen gleichzeitig Betreuung brauchen.

Du bist neugierig auf Software und digitale Produkte und traust dir zu, dich schnell in ein neues Tool einzuarbeiten.

Erste Erfahrung im Umgang mit Beratungs- oder CRM-Software ist ein Plus – kein Muss.

Du erfüllst nicht jede Anforderung? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Uns ist die richtige Einstellung wichtiger als eine perfekte Checkliste – und wir wachsen gemeinsam in die Herausforderungen rein. 🚀

Benefits

👬 Yearly Company Offsite

🍳 Weekly Team Breakfast & Bi-Weekly Lunch

🎉 Regelmäßige Teamevents

🏓 Cooles Office in Berlin mit Ping Pong & Darts

📚 Echte Einblicke in alle Bereiche eines wachsenden SaaS-Startups

jobs.title: Environmental Compliance Consultant
jobs.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

When it comes to environmental consulting, we’re focused on cleaning up our communities today to improve tomorrow. We’re seeking an Environmental Compliance Consultant to perform onsite permitting, monitoring, inspections, and other compliance tasks. You’ll contribute your experience and knowledge to our S&EHS Compliance team.

Based out of our Houston office, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with local and global experts to ensure Jacobs provides best practice solutions. You’ll prepare and deliver high-quality reports and presentations to clients’ technical and senior leadership in accordance with Jacobs’ quality process. Apply your technical experience to develop delivery strategies and develop client relationships while championing safety, quality, and the well-being of your team.

In this position, you will develop your understanding of and promote Jacobs’ solutions and technologies to internal and external stakeholders.

This position may require daily travel to a local client site and other occasional travel to team workshops, presentations, or to conduct site visits. Bring your expertise in Environmental Compliance and desire to work on tough problems, and we’ll empower you to deliver the boldest solutions for our clients.

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations, enabling them to deliver their best work when permitted with client contracts.

Here's what you'll need

Bachelor’s degree in environmental, civil, chemical, or a closely related engineering/technical discipline.
Minimum seven years of professional experience in Texas air quality programs, including Title V and NSR permitting, monitoring, reporting, regulatory applicability analyses, and environmental compliance.
Strong knowledge of Texas and federal environmental regulations, with experience supporting operational compliance at industrial facilities.
Experience serving as a primary client-facing technical resource, managing client relationships, and communicating effectively with clients, contractors, and project teams through strong verbal, written, and technical reporting skills.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, lead projects with limited oversight, direct and mentor staff, and apply strong organizational, interpersonal, and analytical skills.
Understanding of industrial manufacturing and process operations, including direct experience with refineries or petrochemical facilities and the compliance implications of refinery processes.
Professional Engineer (PE) license or ability to obtain licensure within one year of employment.
Ability to work on local client sites daily and travel up to 50%.
U.S. citizen.

Ideally, you’ll also have

Master’s degree in environmental, civil, chemical, or a closely related engineering/technical discipline.
Environmental consulting experience with demonstrated expertise in multimedia environmental compliance, including RCRA, SPCC, stormwater permitting and SWPPP development, TRI/Tier II reporting, LDAR programs, environmental auditing and gap analyses, and compliance management system implementation (e.g., Enhesa).
Experience interpreting stack testing and air dispersion modeling results and applying findings to permitting, reporting, and compliance strategies.
Experience supporting environmental compliance and permitting for industrial operations, including chemical and pharmaceutical manufacturing, foundries and metals facilities, smelters, airports, and capital projects from permitting through operations.
Demonstrated ability to mentor staff and effectively engage with stakeholders through public meetings, community relations, and stakeholder outreach activities.

Our health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you, and in the things you care about. Your health. Your well-being. Your security. Your future. Employees have access to medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance, a 401(k) plan, and the ability to purchase company stock at a discount. Eligible employees may also enroll in a deferred compensation plan or the Executive Deferral Plan. Jacobs has an unlimited U.S. Personalized Paid Time Off (PPTO) policy for full-time salaried/exempt employees, seven paid holidays, and caregiver leave. And certain roles may be eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases, performance discretionary bonus, and stock.

The base salary range for this position is $91,400.00 to $136,000.00. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. Job posted on July 14, 2026. This position will be open for at least 3 days.

At Jacobs, we’re partnering across the globe to create the best project outcomes by maximizing the design, digital technology, and support capabilities of our Global Integrated Delivery (GID) teammates. By joining Jacobs, you’ll commit to supporting and engaging with these teams, as we work to build a company like no other.

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.

Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

new_jobs.description:
Über die Rolle

Du kennst dich aus im Optiker-, Hörakustik- oder Autohaus-Alltag
– mit Kund:innen, Beratung und dem täglichen Spagat zwischen Filiale und Zentrale? Genau dieses Wissen suchen wir. Bei hellomateo betreuen wir hunderte Kund:innen aus genau diesen Branchen, und wir wissen: Niemand versteht ihre Herausforderungen besser als jemand, der selbst mittendrin gearbeitet hat.
Steig bei uns als Customer Success Manager:in ein und bring dein Branchenwissen in ein wachsendes Software-Startup ein. 💚

Über uns
🐨

Wir bei hellomateo machen den Mittelstand wettbewerbsfähig, indem wir seine Kundenbeziehung durch ein persönliches Kommunikationserlebnis stärken. Über 2.000 Unternehmen
wie Rock am Ring, Grohe, Vero Moda, R+V und die Sparkasse setzen bereits auf hellomateo. In den letzten zwei Jahren sind wir um das 4-Fache gewachsen
– und das ist erst der Anfang. 🚀

Aufgaben
In diesen Bereichen machst du den Unterschied:

💻 Onboarding & Betreuung
: Du führst neue Kund:innen aus Optik, Hörakustik und Autohandel eigenständig durch das Onboarding und begleitest sie danach dauerhaft.

📚 Beratung auf Augenhöhe
: Weil du die Branche kennst, verstehst du sofort, wo bei deinen Kund:innen der Schuh drückt – und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen die passende Lösung.

🗣️ Kundenbeziehung ausbauen
: Du baust vertrauensvolle, langfristige Beziehungen zu deinen Kund:innen auf und sorgst dafür, dass sie hellomateo optimal nutzen.

🔎 Erfolg messen & steigern
: Du analysierst Nutzungsdaten deiner Kund:innen, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und sprichst Upsell-Chancen aktiv an.

🤝 Feedback zurückspielen
: Du bist die Stimme deiner Branche im Unternehmen und bringst Kund:innen-Feedback direkt ins Produkt- und Sales-Team ein.

🚀 Schnittstelle sein
: Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Support und Produkt zusammen und trägst aktiv dazu bei, wie wir Kund:innen aus deiner Branche in Zukunft noch besser betreuen.

Qualifikation
Das Wichtigste für diese Rolle ist deine Freude am Umgang mit Menschen – ob im direkten Kontakt mit Kund:innen oder im engen Austausch mit dem Team.

Das bringst du idealerweise mit:

Du hast bereits im Optiker-, Hörakustik- oder Autohandel-Umfeld gearbeitet
– z.B. in Beratung, Verkauf, Filialleitung oder vergleichbarer Kundenbetreuung. Software- oder SaaS-Erfahrung brauchst du dafür nicht.

Du kommunizierst klar und freundlich - auf Deutsch (C2)
und auf Englisch (B2).Du hast Lust, dein Branchenwissen in eine neue berufliche Richtung im Tech-Umfeld einzubringen.

Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich
, auch wenn mehrere Kund:innen gleichzeitig Betreuung brauchen.

Du bist neugierig auf Software und digitale Produkte und traust dir zu, dich schnell in ein neues Tool einzuarbeiten.

Erste Erfahrung im Umgang mit Beratungs- oder CRM-Software ist ein Plus – kein Muss.

Du erfüllst nicht jede Anforderung? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Uns ist die richtige Einstellung wichtiger als eine perfekte Checkliste – und wir wachsen gemeinsam in die Herausforderungen rein. 🚀

new_jobs.title: Environmental Compliance Consultant
new_jobs.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

When it comes to environmental consulting, we’re focused on cleaning up our communities today to improve tomorrow. We’re seeking an Environmental Compliance Consultant to perform onsite permitting, monitoring, inspections, and other compliance tasks. You’ll contribute your experience and knowledge to our S&EHS Compliance team.

Based out of our Houston office, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with local and global experts to ensure Jacobs provides best practice solutions. You’ll prepare and deliver high-quality reports and presentations to clients’ technical and senior leadership in accordance with Jacobs’ quality process. Apply your technical experience to develop delivery strategies and develop client relationships while championing safety, quality, and the well-being of your team.

In this position, you will develop your understanding of and promote Jacobs’ solutions and technologies to internal and external stakeholders.

This position may require daily travel to a local client site and other occasional travel to team workshops, presentations, or to conduct site visits. Bring your expertise in Environmental Compliance and desire to work on tough problems, and we’ll empower you to deliver the boldest solutions for our clients.

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations, enabling them to deliver their best work when permitted with client contracts.

Here's what you'll need

Bachelor’s degree in environmental, civil, chemical, or a closely related engineering/technical discipline.
Minimum seven years of professional experience in Texas air quality programs, including Title V and NSR permitting, monitoring, reporting, regulatory applicability analyses, and environmental compliance.
Strong knowledge of Texas and federal environmental regulations, with experience supporting operational compliance at industrial facilities.
Experience serving as a primary client-facing technical resource, managing client relationships, and communicating effectively with clients, contractors, and project teams through strong verbal, written, and technical reporting skills.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, lead projects with limited oversight, direct and mentor staff, and apply strong organizational, interpersonal, and analytical skills.
Understanding of industrial manufacturing and process operations, including direct experience with refineries or petrochemical facilities and the compliance implications of refinery processes.
Professional Engineer (PE) license or ability to obtain licensure within one year of employment.
Ability to work on local client sites daily and travel up to 50%.
U.S. citizen.

Ideally, you’ll also have

Master’s degree in environmental, civil, chemical, or a closely related engineering/technical discipline.
Environmental consulting experience with demonstrated expertise in multimedia environmental compliance, including RCRA, SPCC, stormwater permitting and SWPPP development, TRI/Tier II reporting, LDAR programs, environmental auditing and gap analyses, and compliance management system implementation (e.g., Enhesa).
Experience interpreting stack testing and air dispersion modeling results and applying findings to permitting, reporting, and compliance strategies.
Experience supporting environmental compliance and permitting for industrial operations, including chemical and pharmaceutical manufacturing, foundries and metals facilities, smelters, airports, and capital projects from permitting through operations.
Demonstrated ability to mentor staff and effectively engage with stakeholders through public meetings, community relations, and stakeholder outreach activities.

Our health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you, and in the things you care about. Your health. Your well-being. Your security. Your future. Employees have access to medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance, a 401(k) plan, and the ability to purchase company stock at a discount. Eligible employees may also enroll in a deferred compensation plan or the Executive Deferral Plan. Jacobs has an unlimited U.S. Personalized Paid Time Off (PPTO) policy for full-time salaried/exempt employees, seven paid holidays, and caregiver leave. And certain roles may be eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases, performance discretionary bonus, and stock.

The base salary range for this position is $91,400.00 to $136,000.00. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. Job posted on July 14, 2026. This position will be open for at least 3 days.

At Jacobs, we’re partnering across the globe to create the best project outcomes by maximizing the design, digital technology, and support capabilities of our Global Integrated Delivery (GID) teammates. By joining Jacobs, you’ll commit to supporting and engaging with these teams, as we work to build a company like no other.

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.

Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.
